newsitem.title: LATVIA: INVESTMENT BANK TO ISSUE 2-YR, ONE MLN LAT BOND.
newsitem.headline: INVESTMENT BANK TO ISSUE 2-YR, ONE MLN LAT BOND.

text.p: The Latvian Investment Bank said on Thursday that it will become the first local issuer of a lat-denominated bond with a one million lat issue.
"The issue prospectus foresees a two-year bond issue worth one million lats," the Investment Bank said in a statement.
"The bonds will be available to both individuals and legal entities," the statement said.
The size of the coupon will be made public later and will be available on the market after the prospectus has been approved by the securities commission, an investment Bank official said.
Commission deputy chairman Talis Laizans earlier said that it has received the prospectus today.
The Investment Bank said the aim of the issue is the creation of capital for the financing of investment projects.
The bank also said that the issue will be included in the Riga stock exchange securities list.
Finnish Merita Bank earlier this month became the first issuer of lat bonds with a two-year issue, worth 15 million lats. Salaspils municipality last year issued $2.8 million of bonds in dollars.
The Investment Bank is an institution of the Latvian government and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) which channels loans to medium and small size businesses.
